[[Canalave Gym]] }} '''Startling Staraptor''' (Japanese: '''VS ムクホーク''' ''VS Staraptor''), titled '''VS Staraptor''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 376th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 39th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Resolution and Confession''' (Japanese: '''決意と告白''' ''Determination and Confession'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Resolve and Confession''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At the [[Team Galactic HQ]], [[Cyrus]] comes to see the Galactic Bomb. The [[Advanced level Grunt]] explains the situation and Cyrus decides to start his plan next week. Meanwhile outside the [[Canalave Gym]], {{adv|Platinum}} is still shocked and cannot continue to stay with {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}}. Meanwhile inside the Gym, Diamond wants to try to talk to her, but Pearl tells that it won't work since [[Byron]] is trying that. Back outside the Gym, Platinum knows that with her father still trapped in the cage, she cannot leave the Gym yet. She then asks what her father is saying, and Byron tells her once they are out of the cube [[Professor Rowan]], [[Mr. Berlitz]], along with her will return to [[Sandgem Town]], which will be the end of her journey with Diamond and Pearl. Afterwards, he suggests she stay at the Gym dorm. That night, Platinum is still thinking and is so tired that she falls asleep. Suddenly the Advanced level Grunt appears and explains the plan to Platinum and tells her that he had come to release her father and Professor Rowan. The Grunt tells her that the Galactic Bomb is intended to capture the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Azelf}}, {{p|Uxie}}, and {{p|Mesprit}}. He goes on and says it will evaporate the lakes in [[Sinnoh]] and it is set to go off in a week. Afterwards, Platinum has a nightmare about losing Diamond and Pearl in the explosion. When she wakes up in the morning she starts writing something. Outside the Gym, Diamond and Pearl surrender their [[Pokédex]]es and [[Pokétch]]es and then turn to leave. However, before they can leave their [[Pokédex]]es beep and Platinum approaches. She starts to read what she had written. Platinum reveals she has also lied throughout her journey with Diamond and Pearl. She then tells them about all the times that she lied to them, such as when she said she could ride a [[bicycle]] but couldn't. She goes on and says that she wants Diamond and Pearl to stay with her, and then reveals her full name, Platinum Berlitz. Afterwards she tells Diamond, Pearl, Professor Rowan, and Mr. Berlitz about Team Galactic's plan and that she is determined to stop them. ==Major events== * {{adv|Platinum}} learns [[Team Galactic]]'s plan. * {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} return their [[Pokédex]]es, but are allowed to keep them. * Platinum reveals her full name to Diamond and Pearl. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Professor Rowan]] * [[Byron]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Advanced level Grunt]] * [[Mr. Berlitz]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Torterra}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s; dream) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s; dream) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Chingling}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) * {{p|Staraptor}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) * {{p|Uxie}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Uxie|Adventures}}; dream) * {{p|Mesprit}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit|Adventures}}; dream) * {{p|Azelf}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf|Adventures}}; dream) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 姆克鷹|VS Staraptor}} (Taiwan)
